scope: Rules-based V2 critic for explosion flash core reads.

detection_rules: HeroExplosionBurst emitter is missing or under-authored.
The explosion lacks a readable dominant outward burst.
hero_sweep_missing.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hero-layer failures force a rebuild.

detection_rules: HeroExplosionBurst does not establish a readable flash-center plus outward-blast read.
no_outside_to_core_read.escalation_rule: Two consecutive failures force a rebuild.

detection_rules: Hero or support layers drift into a smoke-plume silhouette instead of a compact explosive burst.
smoke_plume_silhouette.escalation_rule: If the hero burst reads like smoke twice in a row, rebuild it.

detection_rules: HeroExplosionBurst is rendered as thin ribbon lines instead of a readable blast streak mass.
thin_wireframe_ribbons.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hits force a hero rebuild.

secondary_overwhelms_hero.escalation_rule: Reduce support streaks before touching the hero burst.

detection_rules: Support layers close into a ring shell around the explosion core.
orbit_ring_shell.escalation_rule: Break the ring shell before increasing brightness.

detection_rules: ShockGlow reads like a flat halo instead of a compact explosive bind.
flat_halo_shell.escalation_rule: Tighten the flash shell before adding more support streaks.

detection_rules: CoreFlashMass or ShockGlow reads as soft ambient haze instead of a white-hot flash center.
soft_ambient_glow.escalation_rule: Restore the hot flash center before polishing the outer burst.
